description: Compare the observed SERPINA6 carrier frequency in the southern Italian founder village with the gnomAD-derived population expectation, and assemble the full allelic series of reported human CBG variants
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# A. Founder enrichment test
# Cizza et al. 2011 (PMID 21795453): field survey of the southern Italian
# village from which the original null/Lyon kindred emigrated.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
n_village, n_carriers = 495, 18          # 6 null + 12 Lyon, all heterozygous
p_village = n_carriers / n_village

# gnomAD-derived expectation for the same two allele classes (this session):
q_lyon, q_null = 3.5811e-4, 1.717e-4      # Lyon AF; all pLoF AF summed
p_expect = 2 * (q_lyon + q_null)          # heterozygote frequency, 2q

res = stats.binomtest(n_carriers, n_village, p_expect, alternative="greater")
ci = res.proportion_ci(confidence_level=0.95)

print("=== Founder enrichment in the southern Italian village ===")
print(f"Observed carriers            : {n_carriers}/{n_village} = {p_village:.4f} (3.6%)")
print(f"95% CI on observed frequency : {ci.low:.4f} - {ci.high:.4f}")
print(f"gnomAD expectation 2q        : {p_expect:.6f} (1 in {1/p_expect:,.0f})")
print(f"Enrichment                   : {p_village/p_expect:.0f}-fold")
print(f"Exact binomial P (one-sided) : {res.pvalue:.3e}")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# B. Phenotype within carriers (no non-carrier denominator published)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
print("\n=== Phenotype among the 18 carriers (Cizza 2011) ===")
for lab, n, pain, oa in [("Lyon (D367N) het", 12, 8, 5), ("Null het", 6, 3, 4)]:
    print(f"{lab:<18} n={n:<3} chronic widespread pain {pain}/{n} ({pain/n:.0%})"
          f"   osteoarthritis with pain {oa}/{n} ({oa/n:.0%})")
print(f"{'Combined':<18} n=18  chronic widespread pain 11/18 ({11/18:.0%})")
print("Note: the abstract reports no non-carrier comparison rates, so this is")
print("a within-carrier description, not an effect size.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# C. Allelic series of reported human SERPINA6 variants
# mature numbering (precursor = mature + 22)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
series = [
    # name,                 protein,            class,     CBG level %ref, affinity %ref
    ("CBG null (Melbourne)", "c.121delT fs",     "quantity",  50,  100),
    ("CBG Santiago",         "p.Leu5CysfsX26",   "quantity",  50,  100),
    ("CBG Montevideo",       "haploinsufficiency","quantity", 50,  100),
    ("CBG Trp11Ter",         "p.Trp11Ter",       "quantity",  50,  100),
    ("CBG Lyon",             "D367N / D389N",    "quality",  100,   15),
    ("CBG Leuven",           "L93H / L115H",     "quality",  100,   50),
    ("CBG Athens",           "W371S / W393S",    "quality",  100,    0),
    ("CBG Ser224Ala (S246A)","p.Ser246Ala",      "neutral",  100,  100),
]
print("\n=== Reported human allelic series (heterozygous carrier values) ===")
for nm, pr, cl, lv, af in series:
    print(f"  {nm:<24} {pr:<20} {cl:<9} CBG {lv:>4}%  affinity {af:>4}%")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Figure
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13.5, 5.0))

ax = axes[0]
bars = ax.bar(["Southern Italian\nvillage (Cizza 2011)", "gnomAD expectation\n(Lyon + all pLoF)"],
              [p_village, p_expect], color=["#C44E52", "#4C72B0"],
              edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.6)
ax.errorbar(0, p_village, yerr=[[p_village-ci.low],[ci.high-p_village]],
            fmt="none", ecolor="black", capsize=5, lw=1.4)
ax.set_yscale("log"); ax.set_ylabel("Heterozygous carrier frequency")
ax.set_ylim(1e-4, 0.2)
ax.text(0, p_village*1.9, f"{p_village:.1%}", ha="center", fontsize=11)
ax.text(1, p_expect*1.9, f"{p_expect:.2%}", ha="center", fontsize=11)
ax.set_title(f"A. Founder enrichment: {p_village/p_expect:.0f}-fold excess of carriers\n"
             f"exact binomial P = {res.pvalue:.1e}", fontsize=10)

ax = axes[1]
cmap = {"quantity":"#4C72B0", "quality":"#DD8452", "neutral":"#999999"}
names = [s[0] for s in series]
y = np.arange(len(series))
h = 0.38
ax.barh(y-h/2, [s[3] for s in series], h, label="plasma CBG concentration",
        color=[cmap[s[2]] for s in series], edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.5)
ax.barh(y+h/2, [s[4] for s in series], h, label="cortisol-binding affinity",
        color=[cmap[s[2]] for s in series], edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.5,
        hatch="///", alpha=0.75)
ax.axvline(100, color="black", ls=":", lw=1)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(names, fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlabel("Percent of reference value (heterozygous carriers)")
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc="lower right")
ax.set_title("B. Two mutation classes: truncating alleles cut the amount,\n"
             "missense alleles cut the affinity", fontsize=10)

plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
